description: Tells Claude to use dv in Diversion repos, checkpoints chat before mutating tools, and stamps dv commit with the checkpoint id.

hooks.command: if command -v "dv" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "dv" claude-hook session-start; fi
if command -v "dv" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "dv" claude-hook pre-tool-use; fi
if command -v "dv" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "dv" claude-hook post-tool-use; fi
if command -v "dv" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "dv" claude-hook session-end; fi
